How CMA’s Mastery Training for Deep Coaching Prepares You for MCC Credentialing

The Master Certified Coach (MCC) credential is the highest level of certification a coach can earn from the International Coaching Federation (ICF).  Becoming an MCC is a rigorous journey wherein you need to acquire ICF’s Code of Ethics, Core Competencies, and well-refined coaching techniques.

It is not that master coaches solve any issues, but they help people, organizations, and coaches become their best versions. They offer tools to clients to recognize their own problems, inspect them, dissect them, and solve them in record time in a lasting way. Master Coaches are trained to shift the entire course of a person’s life, no matter who they are or where they come from.

To foster such a huge positive impact, you would need a deeper understanding of the coaching process and that you can learn with Coach Masters Academy (CMA).

Coach Masters Academy offers Mastery Training for Deep Coaching. This is an ICF-approved Level 3 coaching training program that not only prepares you for an MCC credential but also enables you to deepen your understanding of the nature of the change to evoke a profound transformation. Built on CMA’s proprietary Awareness-Clarity-Choice Conversation framework, this program prepares you to coach people for intentional change.

The MCC coaching training by CMA takes your coach training to the next level as it allows you to learn how the transformative moment unfolds and how to use it artfully in your coaching engagements.

Here are the benefits you can achieve with CMA’s MCC Training Program.

1.   The Awareness-Clarity-Choice (ACC) Framework

At the core of CMA’s Mastery Training is the proprietary Awareness-Clarity-Choice (ACC) Conversation framework. This scientific model helps coaches facilitate conversations that lead to deep self-awareness and transformative decision-making. As you master this framework, you will be able to guide clients through reflective processes that allow them to identify and resolve deeply rooted challenges.

The ACC framework is an essential tool that transforms the coaching process from simply addressing surface-level issues to creating intentional and sustainable change, helping you become a more impactful coach.

2.   Understanding of Transformative Change

To coach at the MCC level, it’s essential to deeply understand the psychology of change. MCC Coaching Training offers 80 hours of ICF-approved coaching education, where you will explore how change occurs on a fundamental level.

The course equips you to understand and apply theories of human behavior and consciousness shifts, enabling you to help clients move beyond their current limitations. By exploring how people experience profound shifts in thinking and perception, you will be able to evoke lasting, meaningful transformations.

3.   Preparation for MCC Credentialing

CMA’s Mastery Training for Deep Coaching meets the ICF Level 3 Accreditation requirements, comprising the competencies needed for the MCC credential application. If you are an established coach looking to elevate your skills from PCC to MCC, this training serves as an ideal preparatory program. CMA provides a structured learning path designed to enhance your coaching abilities, ensuring you are well-equipped to pass the rigorous MCC evaluation process. With specialized support from Master Coaches, you will learn to demonstrate MCC-level skills artfully.

4.   Flexible Learning Environment

The coaching training program by CMA is delivered 100% online, making it accessible to coaches worldwide. It is more than simple ZOOM virtual classes or webinars; it offers well-structured online coach training that is truly interactive and engaging. The course is well-structured and truly interactive as it focuses on live coaching sessions, discussion, and feedback from experienced coaches.

Wrapping Up!

With Coach Masters Academy, your MCC credential journey becomes truly transformational, enabling you to foster profound change in clients. You will develop the skills necessary to move clients from confusion to clarity, from hesitation to action, and from indecisiveness to growth.

Upon completion of the program, you will be able to artfully demonstrate key behaviors and competencies that are required for coaching mastery and can apply for an ICF MCC credential.
